post.summary: Creates a competition challenge hint.
post.description: Creates hint content, cost, and optional publication timing for one challenge instance.

get.summary: Lists competition challenge hints.
get.description: Returns every hint and its publication metadata for one challenge instance.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the competition link without changing the global challenge template.

get.summary: Gets a competition challenge.
get.description: Returns management details for published or unpublished competition challenges.

delete.description: Soft-deletes one hint owned by the CompetitionChallenge.

get.summary: Gets a competition challenge hint.
get.description: Returns full hint content and publication metadata to authorized observers.

put.description: Updates hint content, cost, and publication timing for one challenge instance.

get.summary: Gets a competition-scoped flag.
get.description: Returns protected flag material to authorized competition observers.

get.summary: Lists competition-scoped flags.
get.description: Returns protected flag records for one CompetitionChallenge to authorized observers.

post.summary: Restores a deleted competition challenge.
post.description: Restores the competition link; the global template is not modified.

post.summary: Restores a deleted competition challenge hint.
post.description: Restores a soft-deleted hint owned by the selected competition challenge.

post.summary: Creates a template-level static flag.
post.description: Adds protected static flag material to a global challenge template.

get.summary: Lists template-level static flags.
get.description: Returns protected static flag records to authorized template managers.

post.summary: Creates a global challenge template.
post.description: Creates a reusable question-bank template independent of any competition.

get.summary: Lists visible challenge templates.
get.description: Returns owned, managed, shared, or platform-administrator-visible templates.

post.summary: Creates or replaces a challenge-template test Runtime.
post.description: Executes POST /api/v1/admin/challenges/{challengeId}/test-runtimes.

delete.description: Soft-deletes attachment metadata and schedules owned object cleanup.
Soft-deletes protected static flag material from a global template.

get.summary: Gets a template-level static flag.
get.description: Returns protected static flag material to an authorized template manager.

put.description: Replaces protected flag material and validity metadata within the template scope.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an unreferenced reusable challenge template.

get.summary: Gets a global challenge template.
get.description: Returns reusable template metadata according to challenge-bank visibility rules.

patch.summary: Extends a nearly expired challenge-template test Runtime.

delete.summary: Stops the current challenge-template test Runtime.
delete.description: Executes DELETE /api/v1/admin/challenges/{challengeId}/test-runtimes/{runtimeInstanceId}.

get.summary: Gets the latest challenge-template test Runtime.
get.description: Returns protected test Flag and access displays only to template managers and platform administrators.

get.summary: Lists global challenge template attachments.
get.description: Returns protected attachment metadata to authorized template managers.

post.summary: Uploads an atomic challenge attachment batch.
post.description: DeliveryPolicy selects ordinary attachments or RandomOnePerTeam exact-Flag variants.

post.summary: Restores a deleted challenge attachment.
post.description: Restores attachment metadata while preserving its stored object and stable ID.

post.summary: Restores a deleted template flag.
post.description: Restores a soft-deleted template-scoped static flag by stable ID.

post.summary: Restores a soft-deleted global challenge template.
post.description: Restores a reusable template for its owner, a manager, or a platform administrator.

post.summary: Streams a bounded competition archive.
post.description: Administrator, competition owner, and manager only. Protected Flag values require an administrator and an explicit reason.

post.summary: Streams a bounded platform audit archive.
post.description: Exports projections of immutable competition events and platform-administration audit facts as NDJSON.
